title: Grateful Dead Live at Manor Downs on 1982-07-31
source: Source Info: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B)> Tim Dalton's PCM (Sony SLHF400/Sony HG betamax tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording is generally clear but a bit dry and fast‑pitching; the show is fun with strong pacing and standout moments like Candyman, Bird Song and Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The performance captures a steady, high‑energy groove that many fans describe as “fun” and well‑paced, highlighted by memorable renditions of Candyman, Bird Song, It's All Over Now and a soaring Morning Dew. The SBD source is clean enough to be called immaculate by some listeners, yet others note a dry mix, fast pitch and occasional cuts that require correction. Overall the show is enjoyable but technically uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both music and audio, while a detailed 3‑star review points out recording flaws and uneven playing; the weighted average lands around a solid 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and “immaculate” according to two reviewers, but noted as dry, fast‑pitching (requires -1% to -2% correction) and with occasional cuts in the SBD mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Pacing is praised as steady and fun, though one reviewer finds the first set uneven (half train‑wreck) and the second set more engaging.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is described as “trying hard,” faint at times on the OFF mix, misses the first chorus of Brown Eyed Women but recovers for later songs.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lesh’s bass comes forward on Little Red Rooster; otherwise no specific remarks.
band_member_comments.Bob: Brent (Bob) slide practice is highlighted, his harmonics in Space and a brief jam with the drummers are noted.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboard work includes the slide practice, harmonic textures in Space and participation in the post‑drum jam.
band_member_comments.Drums: Standard drum segment followed by an extended jam featuring both drummers and Brent.
